subject: Integrate Crucible into build system
description:
Phase 6 of Crucible integration: Build system and driver profile.

Tasks:
1. Create driver profile (conf/profiles/x64/crucible.mk):
   - conf_drivers_crucible=1
2. Update Makefile:
   - Add drivers/crucible-blk.o when conf_drivers_crucible=1
   - Link libcrucible_osv.a
   - Add dependency tracking
3. Test build:
   - ./scripts/build conf_drivers_profile=crucible image=tests/tst-stat.so
   - Verify driver loads
   - Verify /dev/crucible0 appears

Critical files:
- conf/profiles/x64/crucible.mk
- Makefile (driver conditionals)

Prerequisites:
- Tasks 9, 10, 11 complete (driver fully implemented)

Timeline: 1 week
